svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "Benign and malignant tumours."], [1, "Benign: slow growth, encapsulated, no invasion."], [5, "Malignant: rapid growth that invades surrounding tissue."], [9, "Metastasis: cells break away, travel in the blood and form secondary tumours."]]
svg.title: Tumours and metastasis
svg.desc: A benign encapsulated tumour compared with a malignant tumour invading tissue, whose cells break away into a blood vessel and form a secondary tumour elsewhere.

g.data-info: Grows slowly, stays in one place (often encapsulated), does not invade neighbouring tissue: not cancer (most moles, fibroids), though it may press on organs.
Divides rapidly and invades neighbouring tissues: cancer.
Cells lose adhesion, break away, travel in blood or lymph and form secondary tumours elsewhere. The original is the primary tumour.
